scene: Your camera flash illuminates three secret transit gates behind the wall.
picture: Flat side view on a hidden platform. Far left, water laps around a tethered wooden rowing boat. Left, the curly-haired boy holds his smoking camera. Centre, an open iron freight lift rests beside glowing cables. Right, a glowing brass service elevator stands ready with doors open. Far right, exposed pipes run up the wall.
shown: a wooden rowing boat tied to a canal dock on the left
a clanking iron freight lift with its gate open in the centre
a lit service elevator marked with a radio symbol on the right
